event.name: CTF Treasure Hunt
event.description: A technical treasure hunt for ING's brightest minds
event.duration: depends on the number of challenges

challenges.title: The Hidden Message
challenges.description: Decode the hidden message in the binary sequence
challenges.hint: Think about how text is represented in computers

challenges.title: Network Puzzle
challenges.description: Identify network devices from their descriptions and complete the network diagram
challenges.hint: Match each device description with its common network symbol

challenges.title: Password Strength
challenges.description: Create a secure password that meets all the specified requirements
challenges.hint: Combine different character types in a creative way

challenges.title: HTTP Status Codes
challenges.description: Match the HTTP status codes with their correct descriptions

challenges.title: Git Mystery
challenges.description: Find the secret message hidden in the Git commit history
challenges.hint: Look at the first letter of each commit message

challenges.title: Tech Logo Quiz
challenges.description: Identify the tech companies from partial or distorted logos
challenges.hint: Focus on the distinctive colors and shapes of each logo

challenges.title: Debug the Code
challenges.description: Find and fix the bugs in a simple JavaScript function
challenges.hint: Check for syntax errors, logic issues, and missing elements

challenges.title: IT Crossword Puzzle
challenges.description: Complete the crossword puzzle with IT and programming terms
challenges.hint: Think about common programming languages, hardware components, and tech terminology

challenges.title: Tech Emoji Pictionary
challenges.description: Identify tech concepts represented by emoji combinations
challenges.hint: Think about what each emoji could symbolize in a tech context

challenges.title: Tech Timeline Puzzle
challenges.description: Arrange tech innovations in chronological order
challenges.hint: Consider how technologies build upon each other and when major tech milestones occurred

challenges.title: Decode the Cipher
challenges.description: Crack a substitution cipher to reveal a hidden message
challenges.hint: Look for patterns and common letter frequencies in English
